audience.text: Developers building .NET applications who need to create, read, edit, and convert Word documents without requiring Microsoft Word or paying for commercial licensing.

capabilities.text: Create documents from scratch using the Document class and DocumentBuilder, then edit text, formatting, styles, tables, lists, sections, headers, footers, bookmarks, comments, and footnotes.
capabilities.title: Create and edit Word documents

capabilities.text: Convert documents between DOCX, Markdown, and plain text formats using the Save method with SaveFormat.Docx, SaveFormat.Markdown, and SaveFormat.Text.
capabilities.title: Convert between formats

capabilities.text: Append documents, clone nodes, and import content between documents using AppendDocument, ImportNode, and Clone methods.
capabilities.title: Merge and reorganize documents

capabilities.text: Perform text replacement with regular expressions and formatting-aware options using the Replace methods on the Document class.
capabilities.title: Find and replace text

capabilities.text: Access chart data, series, axes, legend, and data labels through Chart, ChartSeries, ChartAxis, and ChartDataLabel classes.
capabilities.title: Inspect and adjust embedded charts

capabilities.text: Inspect, accept, or reject tracked changes using Revision, RevisionCollection, and AcceptAllRevisions APIs.
capabilities.title: Manage tracked changes

capabilities.text: Check whether DOCX files are signed and untampered, inspect certificates, and remove signatures using DigitalSignature APIs.
capabilities.title: Verify digital signatures

capabilities.text: Protect documents with passwords and round-trip macro-enabled files (DOCM/DOTM) with their VBA projects intact.
capabilities.title: Protect documents

limitations.text: No saving to PDF, XPS, or image formats, and no printing capability.
Layout-dependent field values such as page numbers in a TOC evaluate to placeholders rather than computed values.
Additional formats DOC, RTF, ODT, HTML, and EPUB are not read or written in this edition.
Mail merge, LINQ Reporting, document comparison, document signing, and embedded-font subsetting are not included.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Word document processing in .NET applications without Microsoft Office automation.
Provides a free, open-source alternative to commercial Word processing libraries using the same core engine.
Supports cross-platform document processing on Windows, Linux, and macOS through .NET Standard 2.0 and .NET 8 targets.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Words FOSS for .NET is an open-source .NET library derived from the genuine Aspose.Words commercial codebase, providing document processing capabilities for DOCX, Markdown, and plain text formats.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported formats beyond DOCX, Markdown, and plain text is not fully specified in the facts.
Whether the library supports reading or writing RTF, HTML, or EPUB beyond what is stated in the inherited README is unclear from the fact set.
The specific behavior of layout-dependent fields when evaluated is not detailed beyond placeholder behavior.

workflows.name: Document creation and editing
workflows.text: Developers create new documents using the Document class or DocumentBuilder, then edit content, formatting, tables, and styles programmatically.

workflows.name: Format conversion
workflows.text: Documents are converted between DOCX, Markdown, and plain text formats using the Save method with appropriate SaveFormat values.

workflows.name: Document merging and reorganization
workflows.text: Developers combine documents using AppendDocument, clone content with ImportNode, and reorganize sections and paragraphs.

workflows.name: Revision management
workflows.text: Tracked changes are inspected, accepted, or rejected through the Revision and RevisionCollection APIs.

workflows.name: Field updating
workflows.text: Document fields are updated using the UpdateFields method, though layout-dependent values evaluate to placeholders.

workflows.name: Digital signature verification
workflows.text: Existing digital signatures in DOCX files are verified for authenticity and integrity using the DigitalSignature APIs.
